record.bible_text: The burden<WH04853> of the desert<WH04057> of the sea<WH03220>. As whirlwinds<WH05492> in the south<WH05045> pass<WH02498><WTH8800> through; <FI>so<Fi> it cometh<WH0935><WTH8802> from the desert<WH04057>, from a terrible<WH03372><WTH8737> land<WH0776>.

Prepare<WH06186><WTH8800> the table<WH07979>, watch<WH06822><WTH8800> in the watchtower<WH06844>, eat<WH0398><WTH8800>, drink<WH08354><WTH8800>: arise<WH06965><WTH8798>, ye princes<WH08269>, <FI>and<Fi> anoint<WH04886><WTH8798> the shield<WH04043>.

And he saw<WH07200><WTH8804> a chariot<WH07393> <FI>with<Fi> a couple<WH06776> of horsemen<WH06571>, a chariot<WH07393> of asses<WH02543>, <FI>and<Fi> a chariot<WH07393> of camels<WH01581>; and he hearkened<WH07181><WTH8689> diligently<WH07182> with much<WH07227> heed<WH07182>:

And he answered<WH06030><WTH8799> and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Babylon<WH0894> is fallen<WH05307><WTH8804>, is fallen<WH05307><WTH8804>; and all the graven images<WH06456> of her gods<WH0430> he hath broken<WH07665><WTH8765> unto the ground<WH0776>.

The burden<WH04853> of Dumah<WH01746>. He calleth<WH07121><WTH8802> to me out of Seir<WH08165>, Watchman<WH08104><WTH8802>, what of the night<WH03915>? Watchman<WH08104><WTH8802>, what of the night<WH03915>?

The burden<WH04853> upon Arabia<WH06152>. In the forest<WH03293> in Arabia<WH06152> shall ye lodge<WH03885><WTH8799>, O ye travelling companies<WH0736> of Dedanim<WH01720>.

For thus hath the Lord<WH0136> said<WH0559><WTH8804> unto me, Within a year<WH08141>, according to the years<WH08141> of an hireling<WH07916>, and all the glory<WH03519> of Kedar<WH06938> shall fail<WH03615><WTH8804>:
